description.en-US: Francis de Sales's controversial tracts to the Calvinists of the Chablais (1593-94), in Canon Mackey's English version: the lack of mission in the ministers and the rule of faith, Scripture, apostolic tradition and the authority of the Church.
description.pt-BR: Os escritos de controvérsia de São Francisco de Sales aos calvinistas do Chablais (1593-94), na versão inglesa do cônego Mackey: a falta de missão dos ministros e a regra de fé, a Escritura, a tradição apostólica e a autoridade da Igreja.

en-US.editor: Rev. H. B. Mackey, O.S.B. (London: Burns & Oates, 3rd ed. 1909)

sources.edition: The Catholic Controversy, tr. H. B. Mackey, Library of St. Francis de Sales III (London: Burns & Oates, 1909), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Francis de Sales died in 1622 and the edition is of 1909, so the text is public domain.
